chunks: Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام said to me: “If he reaches the zawāl, then he has attained the standing.”

key_terms.أَدْرَكَ: to reach or attain within the required time
key_terms.الزَّوَالَ: the sun’s passing the zenith; midday time marker
key_terms.الْمَوْقِفَ: the standing place or rite, referring here to the standing at ‘Arafāt

ai.seo_question: What is the minimum time by which a pilgrim must attain the standing at ‘Arafāt for hajj to count?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the time for attaining the standing at ‘Arafāt during hajj. It indicates that reaching the relevant time of zawāl is sufficient for a person to be counted as having attained the standing.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2776 - Mu'awiyah ibn Ammar narrated that

Abu Abdullah (as) said to him:
"If someone reaches the standing (at Arafat) before the sun passes its zenith, they have attained the standing."
